# CC05: 得全阁 Dequan Ge

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC05` · Page: `/scenes/#CC05` · Row: `research/buildings/CC05-dequan-ge/`

## What it was

得全阁 Dequan Ge, south-west of 思永斋 beyond the stream: 得全阁 (plaque 天心水面) with 宝云楼 to the south and 远风楼 to the north (S05 j83:10b-11a; E0145); S361 has three waterside towers facing east, the main one of three bays with double eaves, and two nine-arch bent timber bridges (E0146). Finished 1747; poems 1758-64 (E0140-E0144).

From the inventory row: **built** 1747; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S01, S361).
